facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2012-0189 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 11 November 2012 as a scheduled change under change request; no event precedes it in the record. The change request record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the critical safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
